claims_absent_note: We have ingested no sustainability report or filing from this operator, so there is nothing of its own to hold against the grid. This is a gap in our coverage, not a finding about them.

sites.note: confidence=medium. Project Dorothy's 100 MW sits behind the meter at the Briscoe Wind Farm that Soluna owns, so EIA-930 does not see the load. It historically ran as curtailment-following FLEXIBLE load and is only now seeking ERCOT Base Load status - the flat-load assumption does not hold here. Briscoe County is another Panhandle-but-ERCOT site.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
